command:
set -euo pipefail
VIS=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
BR=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
CAND_BRANCH=chatgpt-vps-work/frank-avatar-go-blink-identity-fix-20260912
CAND_COMMIT=e8d09af9b3fb3df9020ee3956111f3ba99a1ce5d
EXPECTED_DAEMON=5527a1510e4101bcd97a9f57317580638757485d929a9b8e68c3d0ea9d91fcd2
EXPECTED_HTML=87cc0e3a94781f90a7533b129743597753876a8410b868767d243b753c5d3645
EXPECTED_FILM=179f49a31514c02048891ba7f49a1cc7c241c691eaf9a684a4f40094f487d66b
cd "$VIS"
test "$(hostname)" = ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum filmlook.js | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_FILM"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = active
TMP=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/go-avatar-blink-promote-XXXXXX)
BACKUP="$VIS/.go_backups/blink-pre-20260912T0718"
mkdir -p "$VIS/.go_backups"
test ! -e "$BACKUP"
mkdir "$BACKUP"
rollback(){ echo 'ROLLBACK=1'; cp -a "$BACKUP"/blink_*.png "$VIS/augen_blink/"; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' | head -1 | xargs -r -I{} xdotool key --window {} ctrl+shift+r || true; }
trap 'rc=$?; rollback; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit $rc' ERR
cp -a "$VIS"/augen_blink/blink_*.png "$BACKUP/"
git -C "$BR" fetch --quiet origin "$CAND_BRANCH"
test "$(git -C "$BR" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$CAND_COMMIT"
git -C "$BR" show "$CAND_COMMIT:handoff/frank-avatar-round2-candidate/build_blink_eye_local_mask.py" > "$TMP/build.py"
python3 "$TMP/build.py" "$VIS" "$TMP/out" > "$TMP/report.stdout"
echo '=== CANDIDATE REPORT ==='; cat "$TMP/out/report.json"
WIN=$(DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' | head -1)
test -n "$WIN"
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool windowactivate --sync "$WIN"
sleep 2
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" b
sleep 0.16
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority import -window "$WIN" "$TMP/before-old-blink.png"
sleep 0.5
echo "BEFORE_CAPTURE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TMP/before-old-blink.png" | awk '{print $1}')"
cp -a "$TMP"/out/blink_*.png "$VIS/augen_blink/"
echo '=== LIVE FILE HASHES AFTER COPY ==='; sha256sum "$VIS"/augen_blink/blink_*.png | sort
for f in "$TMP"/out/blink_*.png; do n=$(basename "$f"); localh=$(sha256sum "$f"|awk '{print $1}'); liveh=$(curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/$n" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); test "$localh" = "$liveh"; done
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" ctrl+shift+r
sleep 3
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool windowactivate --sync "$WIN"
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" b
sleep 0.16
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority import -window "$WIN" "$TMP/after-new-blink.png"
echo "AFTER_CAPTURE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TMP/after-new-blink.png" | awk '{print $1}')"
identify "$TMP/before-old-blink.png" "$TMP/after-new-blink.png"
compare -metric RMSE "$TMP/before-old-blink.png" "$TMP/after-new-blink.png" null: 2>&1 || true
echo '=== ALPHA EDGE / SUPPORT GATE ==='
python3 - "$TMP/out/blink_006.png" <<'PY'
import sys,struct,zlib
p=sys.argv[1]; data=open(p,'rb').read(); pos=8; ids=[]; meta=None
while pos<len(data):
 n=struct.unpack('>I',data[pos:pos+4])[0]; t=data[pos+4:pos+8]; c=data[pos+8:pos+8+n]; pos+=12+n
 if t==b'IHDR': meta=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',c)
 elif t==b'IDAT': ids.append(c)
 elif t==b'IEND': break
w,h,bd,ct,_,_,inter=meta; raw=zlib.decompress(b''.join(ids)); stride=w*4; prev=bytearray(stride); rows=[]; off=0
def paeth(a,b,c):
 q=a+b-c; return min((a,b,c),key=lambda x:abs(q-x))
for y in range(h):
 f=raw[off]; off+=1; cur=bytearray(raw[off:off+stride]); off+=stride
 for x in range(stride):
  a=cur[x-4] if x>=4 else 0; b=prev[x]; c=prev[x-4] if x>=4 else 0
  if f==1: cur[x]=(cur[x]+a)&255
  elif f==2: cur[x]=(cur[x]+b)&255
  elif f==3: cur[x]=(cur[x]+((a+b)//2))&255
  elif f==4: cur[x]=(cur[x]+paeth(a,b,c))&255
 rows.append(cur); prev=cur
alpha=[[rows[y][x*4+3] for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
perim=max(max(alpha[0]),max(alpha[-1]),max(row[0] for row in alpha),max(row[-1] for row in alpha))
nonzero=sum(a>0 for row in alpha for a in row); opaque=sum(a>=250 for row in alpha for a in row)
print('W',w,'H',h,'PERIMETER_ALPHA_MAX',perim,'NONZERO_FRAC',round(nonzero/(w*h),6),'OPAQUE_FRAC',round(opaque/(w*h),6))
assert perim==0
assert nonzero/(w*h) < 0.25
PY
echo '=== FPS POST ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time,urllib.request,statistics
xs=[]
for i in range(10):
 with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status',timeout=3) as r: d=json.load(r)
 f=(d.get('fps') or {}).get('fps'); print(i,f)
 if isinstance(f,(int,float)): xs.append(float(f))
 time.sleep(1)
med=statistics.median(xs) if xs else 0; print('FPS_MEDIAN',med,'FPS_MIN',min(xs) if xs else None); assert len(xs)>=8 and med>=58
PY
echo 'PROMOTION_GATE=PASS'
trap - ERR
rm -rf "$TMP"
